newsitem.title: USA: North Sea Brent fades in light late day trade.
newsitem.headline: North Sea Brent fades in light late day trade.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil faded in light late day trade that saw one cargo worth of September/October spread trades get done as well as a number of Exchange For Physical (EFP) partial cargoes, traders said.

A total of 500 or one cargo of September/October spread trades were done at minus 11 cents, which based on October EFP values, notionally valued September Brent at $18.95 a barrel or 4 cents under its earlier settlement on the IPE in London.
A European major was the seller and a European trading house was the buyer, traders said.
A number of partial October EFP cargoes were done at $19.05 $19.06 and $19.07 a barrel.
The October/November spread was notionally assessed at minus 14 to minus 10 cents, traders said.
No September paper or EFPs were heard done, however.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Oil Desk +1 212 859 1633
